descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S04 Existing spec: Nursing Home task review has no email button and no mailto

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given One resident on Today's Visits with an open task (unit B) and one resident not on Today's Visits with an open task

When Open /snf/tasks

Then Heading 'Pending Tasks'; no button named Email and no mailto link; the today resident's task and 'Unit B' are shown

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions, evidence for U9 in Nursing Home only. spec-matrix.mjs records the whole test, and the same test asserts that the resident not on Today's Visits is hidden, the opposite of what S12 expects under AC 2 / Q1. So a failure is triaged first: if the failing expectation is the hidden not-today resident ('Should not appear'), it is reported under Q1 / S12, not U9 …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)
